JOIN world_cup_ba9_baseline.world_cup.matches m ON g.match_id = m.id
JOIN world_cup_ba9_baseline.world_cup.teams t ON g.scoring_team_id = t.id
JOIN world_cup_ba9_baseline.world_cup.tournaments tor ON m.tournament_id = tor.id
WHERE tor.year = 2022
AND m.stage IN ('final', 'semi_final', 'quarter_final', 'third_place')
GROUP BY t.name
ORDER BY total_goals DESC;",
